FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE VICE CHAIRMAN
OF THE DELFT PRADESHIYA SABHA
UNDER SECTION 65A (1) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262)AS AMENDED BY LOCAL AUTHORITIES (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT, No. 30 OF 2013
WHEREAS the office of Vice Chairman in Delft Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of Vice Chairman has beenappointed as Chairman ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the United People's Freedom Alliance, the recognized political party to whichSebasthi Pethuru Arulappu the former Vice Chairman belonged, was required by me under Section 65A(1) of the aforesaidOrdinance, to decide upon the member of that Delft Pradeshiya Sabha who belongs to such party who shall be declaredelected as Vice Chairman within a period of thirty (30) days ;
AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has communicated his decision tonominate Mr. Mariyasebastiyampillai Amaladorin, to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE I, Ponnuththurai Kuganathan, Returning Officer of Delft Pradeshiya Sabha, acting in terms ofSection 65A(1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance as amended by filling of vacancies in Local Authorities (SpecialProvisions) Act, No. 30 of 2013 (Chapter 262) do hereby declare Mr. Mariyasebastiyampillai Amaladorin elected as ViceChairman of the Delft Pradeshiya Sabha.
P. KUGANATHAN,Returning Officer,Delft Pradeshiya Sabha.District Elections Office,Jaffna,27th January, 2015.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk.

LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE
Notice under Section 10A(1)(a)
POONAKARY PRADESHIYA SABHA

I, Ponnuthurai Kuganathan, Returning Officer of the Poonakary Pradeshiya Sabha, do hereby declare under Section10A(1)(a) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, (Chapter 262) that Mr. Ponnampalam Siriskantharasa of the PoonakaryPradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of the member of that Council as he has ceased to be a member of the Tamil UnitedLiberation Front.
P. KUGANATHAN,Returning Officer,District Elections Office, Poonakary Pradeshiya Sabha.Jaffna,26th January, 2015.
